artists.source_line: Welcome to the KIZZ ESSENCE ALL IN ONE BEDBURG 2027!🎉

features.rationale: The hotel listed as the main hotel is the same Landhaus Danielshof that is the event location, so the parties and accommodation share one venue.
The description recommends Hotel Gut Hohenholz as another hotel option without it being part of the pass.
A dress code section is stated, with clothing icons, although the day-by-day details are left empty.
